pin.estimand: Target-runtime, different-input replication of b6e9f938: equal-item current-tokenizer cost over 24 conformant multiplicative-comparison repairs against corresponding refused comparatives; least-favourable tokenizer mean.
admissibility_gates: Exactly 24 unique complete comparison pairs, authored before target-manifest inspection and tokenizer import.
Exact (english,ainglish) byte-pair intersection with target b6e9f938 is empty before tokenizer import.
Every pair preserves the named ratio claim while changing only between a registered conformant repair and a refused comparative surface.
cl100k_base, o200k_base, and p50k_base must all encode every pair finitely under target-matched tiktoken 0.14.0.
Every finite result is filed once regardless of agreement, sign, or proposal consequence.

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
row.settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

estimand.aggregation: equal-item aggregate mean per tokenizer; headline is maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.comparator: the corresponding refused more/faster/higher/fewer/less/smaller multiplicative comparative

manifest.freeze: The final runtime identifier and exact target-disjoint pair set are stored by the API before tokenizer import or count exposure.
manifest.method: After stored-manifest mint, compute len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)) for every pair and tokenizer. Average all 24 items equally for each tokenizer. Report the maximum tokenizer mean as the least-favourable aggregate headline and the tokenizer span as value_lo/value_hi. Repair-family means are descriptive only because the target original is aggregate-only. File every finite result once regardless of agreement, sign, or proposal consequence.
manifest.population: 24 fresh complete multiplicative-comparison pairs: six as-many/much/fast, six times-the, six compact-notation, and six decrease repairs; item repair labels are diagnostic only
manifest.selection: All factor values, domains, complete-line renderings, conformant repairs, and refused comparators were authored before opening the target input manifest or importing a tokenizer. Every item states the same named ratio claim in a registered conformant surface versus one refused comparative surface. Iteration counts, per-time rates, percentage-point changes, and unanchored baselines are excluded. Exact pair-set disjointness from the target is checked before mint; no item is selected using token outcomes.
